rationale: The exact decision's provisional NO recommendation is supported within the supplied source perimeter. EO 13910 §§1–4, 85 FR 17001–17002 (PDF pp.1–2). Section 2 delegates DPA antihoarding and implementation powers, requires FEMA consultation and implementing rules; §3 requires periodic reconsideration and publication of withdrawals. The emergency background is not an express automatic sunset of every delegation or reconsideration command. EO 14122 §2, 89 FR 27355 (PDF p.1), explicitly revokes EO 13910, 13991 and 13998 as whole instruments. Its §3 transfer concerns COVID Response Coordinator duties specified in other orders and does not preserve this HHS antihoarding delegation. EO 13910 §4 and EO 14122 §4 preserve independent statutory agency powers/OMB functions; they do not carry forward the revoked delegation as an independent EO 13910 command. Designations, penalties, contracts or enforcement consequences require separate lifecycle treatment. EO 14148's complete §2 list does not include EO 14122, nor does it affirmatively re-enact EO 13910. Revocations of other COVID orders are not revocation of this revoking instrument.
